snippet.title: Screw IT // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/4972300/Screw_IT

Screw It is a cozy, realistic organizing simulator where you sort 777 nails + 1 screw and tidy up your workbench. Use different tools to fix and organize various types of nails. No abilities No pressure, just fix, sort, stock and enjoy the satisfaction of stocking nails in a relaxing environment.

👥 Players: Single-player
🛠️ Developer: Kyre
📚 Publisher: Kyre
📅 Release Date: Sep 19, 2026
🎯 Genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation
